scope: Expression-slot edit preflight using retained applicable namespace bindings and exact-arity all-supplied host keyword signatures.

behavior.namespaces: Captured applicable bindings for effective XPath 4.0; native bindings for existing earlier-profile authoring policy.
behavior.keywords: Retained snapshot registry; declaration-local identities, overloads, include/import winners, EQNames, positional mixtures, arrows and inline bindings.
behavior.refusals: Unavailable prefix: RequiresParentChange with start-tag range; invalid captured namespace context or invalid call: ExpressionParseError; deferred host signature: SlotNotEditable with coverage explanation.
behavior.staticUseWhen: Ordinary runtime function signatures are not supplied to use-when edits.
behavior.resources: No resolver requests during preflight or refusal. Successful candidate re-inspection and explicit compilation retain the existing caller-controlled resolver policy.
behavior.ownership: Only the attribute value is spliced; untouched bytes, native public descriptors, source ranges, correspondence, original snapshots and chained candidate isolation are verified.

publicApi: No new members or enum values; existing refusal descriptions clarified.
knownLimitations: A locally downgraded 3.0 expression in a 4.0 module currently uses native bindings in authoring preflight/validation, while execution uses the module fixed set. A prefix omitted from that set can be accepted by authoring and fail XPST0081 at runtime. This slice preserves the existing authoring policy; that specific test covers preflight/candidate validation only. Review module-level binding policy against the pinned specification and align the paths next.
Optional/default argument execution, conditional/shadow/ambiguous signatures, unresolved/package linkage, pattern/AVT edit support and named-type edit compilation remain outside this slice.
upstream: No native cases added; original five areas/14 cases and PR #27 three cases remain separate, with acceptance and independent confirmation pending.
